stem: What happens next in this passage after “The class discussed design ethics.”?
options: One student said, "I thought a roof was just the top of a building."
After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things.
A bench is not just a bench if its shape decides who is welcome.
A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day."
